text: Redmond Rovers' tactical shift at 65', increasing press intensity, directness, and line height, effectively disrupted Ironvale Athletic’s counter-attacking threat, reducing their xG from 0.97 to 0.17[#1190]. The change visibly improved Redmond’s territorial control, with field tilt increasing to 80.6% and box touches nearly doubling from 5 to 9, despite a drop in overall possession[#1190]. However, fewer shots (3 versus 5 before) and the inability to convert increased pressure into goals suggest the direct approach limited their shooting opportunities[#1190]. To optimize this aggressive pressing style, focus on improving shot volume and quality in the final third to leverage the higher xG created.
